introduction: Ohio HEAP helps eligible households cover part of their home energy costs. A separate crisis request may be needed for an urgent shutoff.
description: Ohio HEAP helps eligible households cover part of their home energy costs. A separate crisis request may be needed for an urgent shutoff.

sections.who: Eligibility depends on household income and the current season’s rules. Ask the local energy assistance provider to assess your household.
sections.get: Assistance varies with household circumstances and available funding; it is not payment of every energy bill.
sections.docs:
• Household names and requested identification.
  • Adult household income records.
  • Recent energy bills and any shutoff notice.
sections.apply:
1. Choose an intake route

    Apply through Ohio Energy Assistance or contact your local Energy Assistance Provider/Community Action Agency.

  2. Complete the request

    Sign the application and supply the requested evidence. Tell the provider about any immediate loss of service.

  3. Follow up

    Keep your submission record and ask whether an emergency appointment is needed.
sections.after: An application does not itself stop disconnection. Speak with your utility about your account while the request is pending.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Ohio Consumers’ Counsel HEAP. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
